description: This file defines a custom ArrayAdapter for displaying LeaveType options in a spinner widget in an Android app. It provides methods to bind LeaveType enum values to UI views, with custom display names retrieved from string resources.

classes.name: LeaveTypeAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter for displaying LeaveType enum options in Android spinner widgets.

methods.name: LeaveTypeAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context and LeaveType values, setting drop-down resource.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Provides the view for the selected item in the spinner.

methods.name: getDropDownView
methods.description: Provides the view for each item in the drop-down list.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly display name for a given LeaveType.
